performance.scope:
Candidate-specific averaged-tack performance and electrical configuration.

Convex combinations of the four solved velocity vectors per wind represent
averaged sailing schedules, not measured polars or resolved tacking trajectories.
Interpolation is limited to the solved wind interval; outside it only drift is
credited and coverage is reported. No extrapolated sailing speed is invented.

candidate.powerPolicy: Maximum operating bus load throughout; maneuver energy remains an explicit extra scenario allowance.

performance.scope: Eight-strip neutral wind profile with bounded local finite-wing coefficients; fixed geometry, quasi-steady force balance and fixed-pitch hydrostatics. No lifting-line redistribution, viscous stall, dynamic recovery or seakeeping qualification.
